Hymn 74: Praise Ye the Lord
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: A-flat Major
Composer: Elroy Huff Aldredge

Category: Praise to the Lord

This is hymn number 74 titled "Praise Ye the Lord" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in A-flat Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Elroy Huff Aldredge and the lyrics were written by Isaac Watts.
This hymn is categorized under: Praise to the Lord.
